verdict.rationale: Channel3's only documented event-driven automation is price-tracking subscriptions: you subscribe to a product and get a webhook notification whenever its price changes. That is a narrow, fixed trigger-action pair rather than user-defined rules. missing for 10: user-defined rule or condition logic (e.g. thresholds or filters), event types beyond price changes, action types beyond webhook notifications, in-depth docs on rule management, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: When you subscribe to price tracking for a product, you can receive webhook notifications whenever the price changes.
